claims.text: The rider's account — that he was at the pickup point and could not see the vehicle — is a party statement, not a chat message: it appears only in the claim text filed on 2026-09-02, the day after the trip, whereas the chat log for the waiting window holds three messages, a single system arrival notice (08:10:21) and two driver messages (08:10:35 and 08:14:10), and no rider message at all. POL-NS-04 limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating rider message in the chat_log, so limb (a) fails on this record and the rider cannot be exonerated under that clause; I do not press it. For completeness, limb (c) is also unavailable to the rider: the platform's own derived rider track places the rider's device 519.37 m from the pin with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0, against a 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius.

The arrival marker cannot be attacked as a false marker under POL-NS-05. At the recorded 'arrived' event (2026-09-01T08:10:20) the driver's own trace places him 24.01 m from the pickup pin — well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — and the trace records a single distinct speed of 0.0 km/h, so the marker is neither taken more than 300 m from the pin nor taken in motion, and no waiting clock falls to be recomputed. POL-NS-02's proximity test is satisfied and the dispute turns on dwell duration under POL-NS-01 limb (c).

The dwell route to a refund is closed on the platform's own arithmetic. The single in-geofence run is 320 seconds — first qualifying fix 2026-09-01T08:10:00, last fix 08:15:20, 33 qualifying fixes — against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, and the derived shortfall_sec is -20.0, that is a surplus and not a shortfall. POL-NS-01 limbs (a), (b) and (c) are therefore made out on these artifacts, and the driver's own termination of the trip at 08:15:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the minimum had elapsed, makes out limb (d). The rider has no shortfall argument on this record and I do not assert one.

The rider's residual submission is about the margin on which this charge stands. The deciding fact clears the 300-second floor by 20 seconds, 6.7 per cent of the minimum, and it is the platform's own derived arithmetic computed on a 10-second sampling interval, with nothing in the bundle corroborating the rider's side of the window at all — no rider message, no in-app call, and a rider track the platform itself dates only from 08:10:30. The driver's own trip record puts the wait at 5.0 minutes exactly (arrived 08:10:20 to cancelled 08:15:20), so the surplus over the minimum exists only because the derived run is dated from the first in-geofence fix at 08:10:00, twenty seconds before the driver's own arrival marker. A charge that stands or falls at the floor, on a single derived computation, should be settled by a human reviewer rather than confirmed by the automated pipeline, and under POL-GEN-03 an escalated fee is held rather than collected. I ask the Judge to place the SGD 4.00 on hold rather than collect it and to escalate under POL-NS-09(a) on a confidence that cannot safely exceed the platform-wide 0.70 floor on this record.

There is no traffic advisory in this bundle: EV-ADVIS-09101-01 is MISSING — status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, severity BLOCKING, weight_multiplier 0.0, no payload — because no advisory matched this pickup road and waiting window. The rider does not assert POL-NS-06(i) against it: a MISSING advisory leaves that accumulation limb unavailable, and asserting it against a missing artifact would be improper rather than exonerating. Its absence is citable, but it gives the rider no ground, because the fee is decided by POL-NS-01 on the arrival and dwell artifacts alone. This claim rests on an artifact at weight 0.0 and is offered only to record the absence honestly.

claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace puts him 24.01 m from the pickup pin — inside the 50 m STANDARD-zone arrival radius fixed by POL-NS-02 — across 33 consecutive 0.0 km/h fixes, and the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 08:10:00 precedes the trip record's 08:10:20 'arrived' event. POL-NS-01 limb (b) is therefore satisfied on clean, unimpaired telemetry.

The driver held position inside the arrival geofence for a continuous 320 seconds, from 08:10:00 to 08:15:20, measured — as POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires — from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' event. That exceeds the 300-second minimum dwell for a STANDARD zone class by 20 seconds.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied: the trip record records no boarding event and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 08:15:20 — the exact moment the 320-second dwell elapsed — with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, not DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. All four limbs of the baseline chargeable no-show therefore hold.

There is no false arrival marker here. At the recorded arrived_at of 08:10:20 the trace shows the driver stationary at 0.0 km/h roughly 24 m from the pin, which is neither more than 300 m away nor at or above the 15 km/h motion threshold POL-NS-05 tests. The waiting clock is not recomputed and limb (ii) of that clause has no application.

POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to remedy: effective in-geofence dwell is 320 seconds against a 300-second STANDARD minimum. The trace yields a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so limb (i)'s accumulation of separate intervals has nothing to accumulate. For completeness, the only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-09101-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) — its absence is citable, but no MISSING advisory can be asserted to accumulate intervals or to excuse a shortfall.

The rider is not exonerated under POL-NS-04. The rider track's 15 fixes sit 519.37 m from the pickup pin, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes rather than undecidable — the rider's device was never within a hundred metres of the pickup point.

POL-NS-04 limb (a) also fails on its own terms. The chat log holds no rider message at all — only the system arrival notice at 08:10:21 and two driver messages, 'I am at the sheltered pickup point beside Block 310' at 08:10:35 and 'Still waiting at the same pickup point' at 08:14:10 — so there is no locating or coordinating message from the rider to trigger that clause.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee, that is SGD 3.20. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by 120 completed trips in 30 days is far below 0.08. Compensation must be paid.

The fee is correctly itemised and no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect exists: the SGD 4.00 cancellation line equals the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so the two fee dimensions coincide and nothing in the fare breakdown compels a partial refund.

The driver's evidence is unimpaired under POL-NS-08 on every limb: no clock skew (arrived event 08:10:20 against a first fix at 08:10:00, a 20-second spread), no trace defect (33 fixes, 100 percent coverage, zero gaps and a 10-second sample interval equal to the expected interval), and no chat defect (3 messages matching the trip record's chat_message_count of 3 with sequential msg_ids). Nothing here is down-weighted.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is engaged on the profile counters the clause names: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so limb (d)'s abuse indicator is absent, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c)'s repeat-pair test is not met. The automated pipeline can rule rather than hold the fee.

The driver's account is corroborated by his own contemporaneous chat messages, which place him at 'the sheltered pickup point beside Block 310' at 08:10:35 and again at the same pickup point at 08:14:10, and by his counterparty statement that he stopped at the app pin, sent two messages and waited until the no-show timer finished. That is a party statement in the chat log, not an inference from geography.

ruling.explanation: The charge stands and the driver is paid. What happened is not seriously in dispute on the instruments. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-09101) places the driver stationary 24.0 m from the pickup pin — inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD zone — for a continuous 320 seconds, from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 08:10:00 to the last at 08:15:20, and the trip record (EV-TRIP-09101) shows an 'arrived' event at 08:10:20 and the driver ending the trip at 08:15:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding. That satisfies all four limbs of POL-NS-01: an arrival event; in-geofence presence at or before it; a 300-second minimum dwell measured from the first fix, here 320 seconds; and a driver-terminated no-show at or after the dwell elapsed. Neither advocate disputes the arrival marker, and none of POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the charge. POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance) cannot apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius. POL-NS-05 (false marker) does not fire: the marker was set stationary at 0.0 km/h 24.01 m from the pin, neither beyond 300 m nor at the 15 km/h motion threshold. POL-NS-06 (dwell shortfall) has no shortfall to remedy — the effective dwell exceeds the minimum by 20 seconds, the derived shortfall_sec is -20.0, and the only advisory artifact (EV-ADVIS-09101-01, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is correctly conceded by the rider as giving no ground: a missing advisory makes accumulation unavailable and cannot excuse anything. On the rider's own case: the account that you were at the pickup point but could not see the car is not borne out. POL-NS-04 requires a locating or coordinating rider message in the chat log before it can exonerate you, and EV-CHAT-09101 holds only the system arrival notice at 08:10:21 and two driver messages (08:10:35, 08:14:10) — none from you — so limb (a) fails. Independence does not save it: the platform's rider track places your device 519.37 m from the pin with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius, so limb (c) fails as well. Your account is a bare assertion filed the day after the trip and does not displace the instrument evidence. On compensation, POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee, that is SGD 3.20, and the anti-farming check does not trip because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4 (and 1 in 120 completed trips is far below 0.08). The fee is correctly itemised under POL-NS-08(d): the SGD 4.00 charged equals the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so no fare defect arises, and there is no clock skew, trace gap or chat truncation to down-weight the bundle. I have considered the rider's submission that the case should be escalated because the deciding margin is only 20 seconds, about 6.7 percent of the minimum, resting on a single derived computation. I do not accept it. POL-NS-09(a) escalates only where confidence falls below the 0.70 floor; here confidence is capped at 1.0 by the weight of the deciding artifacts (all at weight_multiplier 1.0) and I assess it at 0.95. No other POL-NS-09 trigger is met: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the sole-evidence impairment limb is not engaged. The narrowness of the margin is noted, but it is a point to attack with evidence, not a platform escalation trigger, and nothing in the bundle corroborates the rider's side of the window. The driver's two contemporaneous chat messages corroborate his account, but they do not carry this ruling — the arrival and dwell artifacts do, and they are unimpaired. The disputed SGD 4.00 is not refunded; SGD 3.20 goes to the driver under POL-NS-07.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this dispute concerns the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-09101. The fee stands and the driver is compensated.

The charge is validated under POL-NS-01 on all four limbs. (a) The trip record contains a driver 'arrived' event at 08:10:20. (b) The GPS trace places the driver 24.01 m from the pickup pin, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and the first in-geofence fix at 08:10:00 precedes the arrival marker. (c) The driver held position in-geofence for 320 continuous seconds, measured from the first qualifying fix at 08:10:00 to the last at 08:15:20, against the 300-second STANDARD minimum. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 08:15:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding event.

None of the displacing clauses applies. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at the arrival marker the driver was stationary at 0.0 km/h about 24 m from the pin, so the marker is neither remote (300 m) nor in motion (15 km/h). POL-NS-06 yields no shortfall: effective dwell 320 s exceeds the 300 s minimum, and the only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-09101-01, is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so its accumulation limb is unavailable and could not be asserted for either party. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 does not apply: the chat log contains no rider locating or coordinating message, so limb (a) fails, and the platform's rider track places the rider's device 519.37 m from the pin with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 100 m STANDARD radius, so limb (c) fails affirmatively.
